description: You are a literacy specialist at Oakwood Unified School District assessing GCompris for use in a kindergarten reading readiness program. GCompris educational software is open on the screen. Your task is to: (1) Navigate to the Language/Reading section of GCompris and explore ALL THREE sub-tabs — Letters, Words, and Vocabulary — cataloging every activity you find in each sub-tab. (2) Open and interact with at least 4 different language activities spread across these sub-tabs to understand their instructional approach and age-appropriateness. (3) Write a formal Reading Readiness Assessment Report to ~/Desktop/reading_readiness_report.txt. The report must include a clearly labeled section for each sub-tab (Letters, Words, Vocabulary) listing the activity names visible in that section, what reading skill each activity targets, and your recommendation for each activity's suitability for incoming kindergartners (ages 4-6).
